startup.territory_profitability_data:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'Sales Territory'[Group],
    'Sales Territory'[Country],
    "Revenue", [Revenue],
    "Profit", [Profit],
    "GrossMarginPct", [Gross Margin %],
    "UnitsSold", [Units Sold]
)
startup.reseller_leaderboard_data:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    20,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'Reseller'[Reseller],
        'Sales Territory'[Country],
        "Revenue", [Revenue],
        "Profit", [Profit],
        "GrossMarginPct", [Gross Margin %],
        "SalesYoYPct", [Sales YoY %],
        "YOYTarget", [YOY Target]
    ),
    [Revenue],
    DESC
)
startup.key_performance_indicator_totals:
EVALUATE
ROW(
    "Revenue", [Revenue],
    "Profit", [Profit],
    "GrossMarginPct", [Gross Margin %],
    "Orders", [Orders],
    "UnitsSold", [Units Sold],
    "AvgOrderValue", [Avg Order Value],
    "SalesVsPY", [Sales vs PY],
    "SalesYoYPct", [Sales YoY %]
)
startup.semantic_model_schema:
EVALUATE
UNION(
    SELECTCOLUMNS(
        FILTER(
            INFO.VIEW.COLUMNS(),
            [Type] <> "RowNumber" &&
            [DataCategory] <> "RowNumber" &&
            [IsHidden] = FALSE() &&
            NOT(CONTAINSSTRING([Name], "RowNumber"))
        ),
        "Table", [Table],
        "Name", [Name],
        "Type", "Column"
    ),
    SELECTCOLUMNS(
        FILTER(
            INFO.VIEW.MEASURES(),
            [IsHidden] = FALSE()
        ),
        "Table", [Table],
        "Name", [Name],
        "Type", "Measure"
    )
)
